bpa_rules.initial_screen: Choose 10 mm as an initial candidate if target MIF <= about 0.5 * Fmax10(L0=Lmax of replaced muscle); then verify torque, strain, transmission and packaging. This is not a hard threshold or a claim that all muscles use 20 mm.

centerline_rule: For every candidate attachment, transform into pelvis coordinates and require seed_side_sign * z_pelvis >= 0 at every evaluated pose. Preserve side ownership; never take abs(z) as a correction. Handle near-zero seed points explicitly.
modeling_limits: Catalog sheave diameter is not assumed to be the wire pitch diameter.
Groove profile is a schematic interpolation between catalog envelope dimensions, not supplier CAD.
Plate, guard, ferrule length, boss and bend-radius preview dimensions are proposed, not catalog dimensions.
No family has an assembly WLL until cable, terminations, pin, bearings and bracket have been checked.
No high-load bicycle housing is approved merely from its 5 mm diameter.
